title: atropis distans var. tenuifolia
intro: Atropis distans var. tenuifolia, commonly known as Chinese Angelica or Dong Quai, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing menstrual cramps and regulating menstrual cycles, as well as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Atropis distans var. tenuifolia include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional Chinese medicine for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ferulic acid, coumarins, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
